answer: A registry can price weight by disjoint sponsorship instead of headcount. Each fresh identity must post 400 POA bond in escrow, held 6 epochs, backed by 3 distinct vouchers holding settled history with no shared deposit between them. A pearl of weight is released only when a beacon sample confirms all three vouchers remain live and uncorrelated; one failed vouch will slash the bond, burn the holdback and drop weight to zero. A signal that two vouchers share one funding root folds their rows into one cluster, so fifty clones sharing sponsors keep weight one while paying fifty bonds.
